buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Subject: Procurement of Smartphone for Official Use 1. Technical Specifications: The smartphone supplied shall conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the GeM bid, including Android 15 or higher, RAM of 8 GB or higher, internal storage of 128 GB or higher, support for 2G/3G/4G LTE/5G networks, display size of 6.0 inches or above, and b attery capacity of 5,000 mAh or above. 2. Make and Model: The bidder shall clearly mention the make, model number and detailed technical specifications of the smartphone offered. The offered product must comply with all the essential tec hnical requirements specified in the bid. 3. Genuine Product: The supplied smartphone shall be brand-new, unused, non-refurbished and non -reconditioned, in original sealed packaging, and shall not be a discontinued model. 4. Warranty: The smartphone shall carry a minimum one-year manufacturer's warranty from the date of acceptance of the product, or such longer warranty as specified in the GeM catalogue or bid. 5. Accessories: The supplier shall provide all standard accessories included with the offered model, s uch as the charging adapter, USB charging/data cable and other accessories, wherever applicable, a s per the GeM catalogue and bid requirements. 6. Delivery: The smartphone shall be delivered to the consignee at the address specified in the GeM c ontract within the stipulated delivery period. 7. Verification and Acceptance: The consignee shall verify the make, model, IMEI number, operatin g system, RAM, internal storage, network compatibility, battery specifications and physical conditio n of the supplied smartphone before acceptance. 8. Documents: The supplier shall provide the original tax invoice, manufacturer's warranty details an d official product specification sheet or manufacturer's website link for verification at the time of deli very. 9. Defective Product: Any product found defective, damaged, tampered with, or not conforming to t he specifications of the bid shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and con ditions. 10. Compliance: All supplies shall be made in accordance with the GeM General Terms and Conditions, applicable Special Terms and Conditions, bid specifications and applicable Government procuremen t rules. 11. Payment: Payment shall be processed as per the applicable GeM terms and conditions after satisfa ctory delivery, verification and acceptance of the goods by the competent consignee. Note: All technical and commercial conditions shall be subject to the applicable GeM rules and conditions. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a
registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.
